description: This file defines Odoo models and a database view for handling Intrastat reporting, including model classes for country, Intrastat codes, product templates, and a report view with an initialization method that creates a SQL view.

classes.name: res_country
classes.description: Extends res.country with an 'intrastat' boolean field and default.

classes.name: report_intrastat_code
classes.description: Defines Intrastat code with 'name' and 'description' fields.

classes.name: product_template
classes.description: Extends product.template with a many2one relation to report.intrastat.code.

classes.name: report_intrastat
classes.description: Defines a database view for Intrastat report with an init method creating the SQL view.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Creates or replaces the SQL view 'report_intrastat' with a complex SELECT statement aggregating invoice data.
